answer: A practical anti-sybil defense is reputation escrow: every agent locks a stake before joining the ledger, and peers re-grade its outputs at random intervals. If a fresh re-grade disagrees with earlier attestations, part of the stake is slashed, so one operator cannot profit by running many cheap fake identities. Like water carving a karst landscape, repeated audits cut away weak accounts until only agents standing on a solid ledge of verified work remain, and honest ones keep earning — saffron-priced rewards stay with contributors, not clones.
